title: Evaluating Students' Perspectives on ICT Readiness in Somali Higher Education towards Teaching - Learning Acceptance
reasoning: The paper is an empirical study applying the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) to understand students' readiness for Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in Somali higher education. Its focus is on technological and psychological factors like perceived usefulness, ease of use, optimism, and self-efficacy. There is no component related to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
